graph.description: The graph that we are conducting the fusion optimization over.

membership.description:
This represents a rudimentary implementation of a disjoint set data structure, which tracks group membership for each
vertex. The key is the vertex id, and the value is the vertex id of its "parent" vertex in the group. If a vertex is its own parent, then that
means it is the leader of its group. Membership should be initialized with all vertices being their own parent.

title:
{@link Workflow.FusionContext} is the intermediate context used by the visitor {@link Workflow.FusionVisitor}.
It tracks updates to {@link #membership} as vertices are fused into groups.
name: Workflow.FusionContext
